set.body: Goal: SvgRenderer emits CSS calc() strings for mixed-unit LengthExpr and anchored rects, and percentage units for npc lengths. calc() is not valid in SVG geometry attributes, and Canvas/Java2D/JavaFX backends have no calc at all, so LengthExpr must be resolvable to concrete numbers before any backend emits output. Add a length-resolution context in the graphics module (document size, dpi, enclosing viewport frame) that evaluates LengthExpr/ExtentExpr to doubles per unit, and have backends consume resolved values. Acceptance: portable resolver in shared graphics with unit tests covering npc, native, pt/mm/cm/inch, Add/Sub/Mul, and nesting through viewports; SVG emits numeric attributes only (no calc(); percentages only where semantically exact); renderer conformance asserts backend output contains no unresolved expressions; graphics and graphics-svg JVM/JS tests pass.
set.title: Graphics: resolve length expressions numerically at the render boundary
